name: Grow a Dancing Hotdog!
desc: This game is a remade version of the original "GROW A DANCING HOTDOG!". This was part of my childhood when I was younger, but there was a glitch and it was almost borderline unplayable. So I decided to make a recreation of one of the many childhood games. Here is the original - https://www.roblox.com/games/957689977/GROW-A-DANCING-HOTDOG
